title: Ontology Change Proposal Request
description: Suite-side client payload for POST /api/v1/ontology-ops/change-proposals. Mirrors the ArcaQ ChangeProposalIn model; product-side source of truth is arcaq-api.

concept_uri.description: Full URI of the affected concept

description.description: Human-readable description of the proposed change

proposed_ttl.description: Optional Turtle snippet; syntax validated at submit (HTTP 422 on invalid)

proposer.description: Optional explicit proposer identity; defaults to the authenticated caller at ArcaQ

entry_point.description: Surface that submitted the change. Always "suite" from Suite modules; "direct" for ArcaQ UI/API users.
